description: An empty verbatim constituent has empty value, image and text, and claims no gap. Its source is empty at the preceding input token's source end (engine §11.1, §12).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text [{part}]
%rule part letter | comma
%rule letter "a" | "b" %emits $ :: L

%rule comma ","
```
